nfl.oneThing: The Falcons beat the unbeaten 49ers 29–20 on Sunday, forcing four turnovers in the upset. It was San Francisco's first loss of the season.

headlines.title: Falcons upset unbeaten 49ers
headlines.summary: Atlanta beat San Francisco 29–20 and ended the 49ers' perfect start. The Falcons forced four turnovers and scored 13 points off them. Michael Penix Jr. completed 25 of 34 passes for 213 yards and three touchdowns, and Drake London had seven catches for 66 yards and a touchdown. Rookie linebacker Kendal Daniels had an interception and a fumble recovery, and his 29-yard return set up a field goal that gave Atlanta a two-possession lead. Christian McCaffrey left for much of the first half with a thigh injury, but the reports say it doesn't appear to be serious.
headlines.whyItMatters: San Francisco is still 6-1 and second in the NFC. Atlanta, now 3-4, is 1.0 games back of the last playoff spot.

headlines.title: Bengals beat the Ravens without Lamar Jackson
headlines.summary: Cincinnati won 35–13 at Baltimore after a slow first half. Joe Burrow threw four touchdown passes in the second half and finished 22 of 30 for 292 yards. Tee Higgins had six catches for 148 yards and a touchdown. Jackson was sidelined with a left ankle sprain, and Tyler Huntley threw for 298 yards with one touchdown and one interception for Baltimore. It was the Ravens' second straight divisional loss.
headlines.whyItMatters: The Bengals improve to 4-2 and sit seventh in the AFC. Baltimore is 4-3 and 0.5 games outside the last playoff spot.

headlines.title: Browns win again with a late drive, Titans drop to 1-6
headlines.summary: Cleveland beat Tennessee 27–24. Deshaun Watson led his fifth game-winning drive in the fourth quarter this season, connecting with Harold Fannin Jr. on a 36-yard catch-and-run before Andre Szmyt kicked a 32-yard field goal. Quinshon Judkins ran for 96 yards and two touchdowns, and KC Concepcion had eight catches for 129 yards. For Tennessee, Tony Pollard ran 25 times for 129 yards and three touchdowns, but it was the Titans' sixth loss of the season.
headlines.whyItMatters: Cleveland moves to 5-2 and third in the AFC. Tennessee is 1-6 and 15th in the AFC.

headlines.title: Giants beat Texans in overtime, Skattebo hurts hamstring
headlines.summary: New York beat Houston 27–21 in overtime. Cam Skattebo finished with 17 carries for 124 yards and a touchdown. In overtime he ran 42 yards to the Houston 30, and Devin Singletary scored on the next play. J.J. McCarthy completed 20 of 28 passes for 252 yards. Houston had tied the game late, and C.J. Stroud threw for 153 yards and two touchdowns. Skattebo told ESPN he 'felt something in his hamstring' on his final carry of the game.
headlines.whyItMatters: New York moves to 4-2-1 and third in the NFC. The Giants have a bye in Week 8, which ProFootballTalk says could be good news for Skattebo.

headlines.title: Dolphins win first game, 28–25 over Jets
headlines.summary: Miami beat the Jets 28–25 for its first win of the season. Malik Willis went 14 of 21 for 208 yards with two touchdown passes and also ran in a score. Miami led 21–7 at halftime. New York cut the lead to four in the fourth quarter, but then gave up a 63-yard touchdown. Geno Smith threw for 287 yards and three touchdowns for the Jets, and Omar Cooper Jr. had 115 receiving yards. Aaron Glenn said he was 'disappointed in myself first and foremost' about the defence in the first half.
headlines.whyItMatters: The Jets drop to 2-5 and sit 11th in the AFC. Miami is 1-5 and 14th. Glenn still believes the team is on the right track.

headlines.title: Vikings stay unbeaten, beat Colts 16–10
headlines.summary: Minnesota beat Indianapolis 16–10 to improve to 6-0. The Colts led 10–6 at halftime but could not score in the second half. Daniel Jones completed 13 of 22 passes for 108 yards and threw an interception on the final drive, his seventh decisive interception. Jonathan Taylor ran 18 times for 95 yards and a touchdown. Indianapolis has lost three straight and is 2-5. Its minus-8 turnover margin was the worst in the NFL going into the day.
headlines.whyItMatters: Minnesota has six straight wins and sits first in the NFC. The Colts are 12th in the AFC.

teamNews.title: Raiders and Rams under way
teamNews.text: The Raiders' game against the Rams was still in progress in the data. Matthew Stafford threw a 3-yard touchdown pass to Davis Allen to give the Rams a 7–0 lead, and Matt Gay missed a 51-yard field goal earlier. The Raiders have since put points on the board with a 30-yard field goal.

teamNews.text: Trent McDuffie is among the Rams' inactives for the game at Las Vegas. Puka Nacua is active despite a calf issue, which is a relief for a Rams team that has been hit by injuries.

Kendal Daniels' fourth-quarter interception and fumble recovery sealed it for Atlanta. Brock Purdy threw for 288 yards but had two interceptions, and George Kittle had eight catches for 88 yards.

Watson's late drive set up the field goal, even though he had 308 yards passing with no touchdowns and an interception. Tennessee got its offence from Pollard, who scored three times, while Cam Ward threw for 181 yards with an interception.

nba.oneThing: Pistons centre Jalen Duren will miss at least two weeks with a right hamstring strain, a big loss for the 2-0 Pistons.

headlines.title: Jalen Duren out at least two weeks with hamstring strain
headlines.summary: Detroit centre Jalen Duren has a right hamstring strain and will miss at least two weeks. He was hurt in the Pistons' game at Miami on Friday and will be re-evaluated in two weeks. If he misses that long, he is expected to be out for Detroit's next six games. Paul Reed will start in his place. Duren signed a five-year extension earlier this month and is the anchor in the middle for the Pistons on both ends of the court. Philadelphia faces Detroit on Sunday without Duren.
headlines.whyItMatters: Detroit is 2-0 and second in the East. Without Duren, the Pistons' depth in the middle will be tested.

headlines.title: Sixers stay unbeaten behind Embiid's triple-double
headlines.summary: Joel Embiid had 28 points, 11 rebounds and 10 assists in a 127–116 win over Milwaukee, his tenth career triple-double. Jaylen Brown scored 27 on his 30th birthday, and Tyrese Maxey added 26. LeBron James was out with lower back pain management but is expected to play Sunday. Embiid was then ruled out for Sunday's game against Detroit with right foot plantar fasciitis, after he had asked to play. Embiid has averaged 49 games a season over his 10 years.
headlines.whyItMatters: Philadelphia is 3-0 and first in the East. Keeping Embiid healthy is the priority for a team that will need him over a long season.

headlines.title: Jokic and Murray rally Nuggets past Pelicans in overtime
headlines.summary: Denver came back from 23 points down to beat New Orleans 141–135 in overtime. Jamal Murray scored 42 with eight three-pointers, and Nikola Jokic had 35 points, 15 rebounds, 10 assists and three blocks. It was Jokic's 199th career triple-double. Afterwards he said fans who booed during the comeback were 'not welcome anymore'. Trey Murphy III had 26 points for the Pelicans, who are 0-3.
headlines.whyItMatters: Denver is 1-1 and eighth in the West. New Orleans is 0-3 and 14th in the West.

headlines.title: Booker scores 43 as Suns beat Warriors
headlines.summary: Devin Booker had 43 points, seven rebounds and seven assists in Phoenix's 131–122 win over Golden State. Yaxel Lendeborg had 26 points, nine rebounds, five assists and six threes for the Warriors, but Golden State dropped to 0-3. Booker is averaging 33.0 points a game, second in the league. The Suns' point guards have been a question after two games, and Booker's load has been heavy.
headlines.whyItMatters: Phoenix is 1-1 and tenth in the West. Golden State is 0-3 and 15th in the West.

teamNews.title: Spurs get first win in Dallas
teamNews.text: San Antonio snapped its 0–2 start with a 122–106 win at Dallas. Mitch Johnson called a timeout after Daniel Gafford's dunk put the Mavericks up 49–43 in the second quarter, and the Spurs took over in the fourth. Air Alamo credits Stephon Castle's offensive versatility as a key factor.

teamNews.title: Tarris Reed's short stint
teamNews.text: Tarris Reed's brief minutes in the win have started a conversation about the backup centre role, according to Air Alamo. Sports Illustrated says he seized the moment.

teamNews.title: Tobias Harris debut coming soon
teamNews.text: Tobias Harris, who is out with a left calf strain, is expected to make his Spurs debut soon, the Express-News reports.

contextCard.title: How the NBA play-in tournament works
contextCard.body: Teams that finish 7th to 10th in their conference play in the play-in tournament. The 7th and 8th place teams play each other, and the winner takes the 7th seed. The loser then meets the winner of the 9th versus 10th game for the 8th seed. Teams that finish 11th or lower in the conference are eliminated from the play-in.
